arabic text:
AI MERE MOLA MERE AAQAA HAI YEH TERI ATA
MARTABA BAKHSHA HAI MUJHKO YE AZEEM O AALA
SAB MUJHE KEHTE HAIN MAIN HOO’N TERA BANDA MOLA
IZN AB KARDEI’N ATA
AY SHAHE KARBOBALA
MUHKO BHI KARDEIN ATA ROZE KA DEEDAR YA HUSSAIN
english translation text:
O my Maula, my Master, this is your gift.
You have granted me this great and exalted rank:
everyone calls me your servant, Maula.
Now grant me permission,
O King of Karbala;
grant me the sight of your shrine, O Hussain.

arabic text:
CHAL KE PAIDAL MAI’N NAJAF SE TERE DAR TAK AAYA
GHAM BOHAT DOOR HUWE DIL KO SUKOO’N MILNE LAGA
SAJDA E SHUKR KIYA AAPKI CHOKHAT PE ADA
KYUN BHALA MANGU DUA
AAP KO SAB HAI PATA
TERE DEEDAR KO AYA THA YEH ZAWWAR YA HUSSAIN
english translation text:
Walking from Najaf, I reached your door.
Many sorrows left me, and my heart began to find peace.
At your threshold I performed a prostration of gratitude.
Why should I even ask?
You already know everything.
This visitor came only to behold you, O Hussain.

arabic text:
SAAYE MEI’N PARCHAM E ABBAS KE JAB AATE HAI’N
KHAUF E DUNYA KA KOI DIL ME NAHI LAATE HAI’N
MAUT GHABRATI HAI HUM TO NAHI GHABRAATE HAI’N
AE SHEHNSHAAH E UMAM
HAI BAHATTAR KI QASAM
TUM PE JAA’N DENE KO HUM REHTE HAI’N TAYYAR YA
HUSSAIN
english translation text:
When we enter beneath Abbas's standard,
we carry no fear of the
world within our hearts. Death itself
fears us; we do not fear
it. O King of the nations, by
the seventy-two, we remain ready to
sacrifice our lives for you, O Hussain.

arabic text:
WADA NANA SE KIYA THA JO NIBHAYA TUM NE
DEEN KO ZULM KE HAATHON SE BACHAYA TUM NE
NOK E NAIZA SE BHI QUR’AN SUNAYA TUM NE
BACH GAYA DEEN E KHUDA
KAAM HAI TERA BARA
AAP PE TUTAY MASAIB KE HAI ANBAR YA HUSSAIN HOGAYA
QASIM E NOSHAH KA PAAMAAL BADAN
LAASH ABBAS KI AKBAR KI THI BE GORO KAFAN
HAYE PARDES ME TANHA THE SHEHNSHAHE ZAMAN
HAR QADAM ZULM SAHA
KARDIYA WADA WAFA
BAYAT E ZUM KA KARTE RAHE INKAAR YA HUSSAIN
english translation text:
You fulfilled the promise made to your grandfather.
You protected the faith from the hands of oppression.
Even from the spear-point, you recited the Qur'an.
The religion of God survived;
your deed was immense.
Mountains of calamity fell upon you, O Hussain.
The body of the bridegroom Qasim was trampled;
Abbas and Akbar lay unburied and unshrouded.
Alas, the King of the age stood alone in exile.
At every step you endured cruelty,
yet fulfilled your promise
and continued refusing allegiance to oppression, O Hussain.

arabic text:
AAP THE TEEN SHAB O ROZ KE PYAASE MOLA
AAP NE LAASHE BAHATTAR KE UTHAE TANHA
AUR PHIR NAADE ALI PARH KE KIYA KHUD HAMLA
DEKH KAR JANG TERI
AY HUSSAIN IBN E ALI
DAAD DETE THE TUJHE HAIDER E KARRAR YA HUSSAIN
english translation text:
You remained thirsty for three days and nights, Maula.
You lifted the bodies of all seventy-two alone,
and then, reciting Nad-e-Ali, entered battle yourself.
Watching your battle,
O Hussain son of Ali,
even Haider-e-Karrar praised you, O Hussain.

arabic text:
NOK E NAIZA PE AJAB AAP NE MANZAR DEKHA
EK NAIZAY PE THI KULSOOM KI ZAINAB KI RIDA
EK NAIZAY SE THA SAJJAD KO MAARA JATA
YE AJAB ZULM HUWA
RO PARI KHALQ E KHUDA
TU HAI MAZLOOM BOHAT SAYAD E ABRAAR YA HUSSAIN
english translation text:
From the spear-point you witnessed an extraordinary scene:
on one spear were Kulsum's and Zainab's veils;
from another, Sajjad was being struck.
Such cruelty occurred
that all creation wept.
You are deeply oppressed, O chief of the righteous, O Hussain.

arabic text:
HUMNE MAA’N BAAP SE SEEKHA HAI YE AZLAAN O
KARIM
HUM NE PAAYI HAI YEHI FARSHE AZA SE TAALEEM
DIL SE KARNI HAI HUSSAIN IBNE ALI KE TAZEEM
BIBI ZAHRA KI QASAM
AAP KI QAUM HAI’N HUM
AAP HI TO HAI’N MERE SAYED O SARDAAR YA HUSSAIN
english translation text:
O Azlaan and Karim, we learned
this from our parents and received
this teaching from the mourning floor:
to honour Hussain son of Ali
from the heart. By Lady Zahra's oath,
we are your people. You alone
are my Sayyid and Master, O Hussain.
